description_en: Retrieves a template, including its content
description_zh: 获取一个模版，包括内容
kebab_example: aliyun oos get-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-name MyTemplate --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The template version. Format: v + number. Valid values: v1 to v200
parameters.help_zh: 模板版本。格式：“v”+数字。取值范围：v1-v200
parameters.name: template_version

Content.example:
"FormatVersion: OOS-2019-06-01 Description: en: Creates an ECS image zh-cn: 创建一个ECS镜像 name-en: Create Image name-zh-cn: 创建镜像 categories: - image_manage - application_manage Parameters: regionId: Type: String Label: en: RegionId zh-cn: 地域ID AssociationProperty: RegionId Default: '{{ ACS::RegionId }}' instanceId: Label: en: InstanceId zh-cn: ECS实例ID Type: String AssociationProperty: ALIYUN::ECS::Instance::InstanceId AssociationPropertyMetadata: RegionId: regionId imageName: Label: en: ImageName zh-cn: 新镜像的名称 Type: String Description: en:

Note:

  • Length is 2~128 English or Chinese characters
  • must start with big or small letters or Chinese, not http:// and https://.
  • Can contain numbers, colons (:), underscores (_), or dashes (-).
zh-cn:

注意：

  • 长度为2~128个英文或中文字符
  • 必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。
  • 可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
tags: Label: en: Tags zh-cn: 镜像标签 Type: Json AssociationProperty: Tags AssociationPropertyMetadata: ShowSystem: false Default: [] OOSAssumeRole: Label: en: OOSAssumeRole zh-cn: OOS扮演的RAM角色 Type: String Default: OOSServiceRole RamRole: '{{ OOSAssumeRole }}' Tasks: - Name: createImage Action: ACS::ECS::CreateImage Description: en: Create new image with the specified image name and instance ID zh-cn: 通过指定实例ID和镜像名称创建新的镜像 Properties: regionId: '{{ regionId }}' imageName: '{{ imageName }}__on_{{ ACS::ExecutionId }}_at_{{ Acs::CurrentDate }}' instanceId: '{{ instanceId }}' tags: '{{tags}}' Outputs: imageId: ValueSelector: imageId Type: String Outputs: imageId: Type: String Value: '{{ createImage.imageId }}' Metadata: ALIYUN::OOS::Interface: ParameterGroups: - Parameters: - regionId - instanceId Label: default: zh-cn: 选择实例 en: Select Ecs Instances - Parameters: - imageName - tags Label: default: zh-cn: 镜像设置 en: Image Configure - Parameters: - OOSAssumeRole Label: default: zh-cn: 高级选项 en: Control Options"

CreatedBy.description_en: The user who created the template

CreatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was created

Description.example: "{\"en\": \"Creates an ECS image\", \"zh-cn\": \"创建一个ECS镜像\", \"name-en\": \"Create Image\", \"name-zh-cn\": \"创建镜像\", \"categories\": [\"image_manage\", \"application_manage\"]}"

HasTrigger.description_en: Indicates whether the template contains a trigger

Hash.description_en: The SHA-256 hash of the template content

ShareType.description_en: The sharing type of the template. The sharing type of user-created templates is Private
ShareType.description_zh: 模板共享类型。目前用户创建的模板的共享类型均为 Private

SharedAccounts.description_en: The accounts with which the template is shared

Tags.description_en: The tag keys and values. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
Tags.description_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20

TemplateFormat.description_en: The template format. The system determines the format, which is JSON or YAML
TemplateFormat.description_zh: 模板格式。系统字段判断，为JSON或YAML

TemplateVersion.description_en: The template version. The version is in the format of "v" followed by a number, starting from 1
TemplateVersion.description_zh: 模板版本。以“v”+数字的形式，数字从1开始

UpdatedBy.description_en: The user who last updated the template

UpdatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was last updated
